name: video-facade
title: Video facade
description: A poster that becomes the player only when pressed, so a page with a video loads no video code and makes no third-party request until it is wanted.
docs: Pass provider (youtube, vimeo or file), videoId or src, poster, title and duration. Before the press there is one button with the poster, a play button, the title and the length, and a line under it names the provider that will load; no request is made to YouTube or Vimeo. Pressing swaps in the player (YouTube no-cookie, Vimeo with do-not-track, or a video element), starts it and moves focus into it. onActivate gets the click: call event.preventDefault() to keep the poster while you ask for consent. aspect is the shape of the frame, and a missing or broken poster falls back to a block with the title.
